abstract: Primary extragonadal seminoma (EGS) is a rare tumor of young adults that often presents with bulky primary tumors and metastatic disease. Long-term survival is inadequate with conventional therapy consisting of radiotherapy with or without surgery. The charts of 21 patients with EGS treated initially either with conventional therapy (group I) or with multimodality therapy including initial chemotherapy with high doses of cisplatin followed by either radiotherapy or surgery or both (group II) were reviewed. Five of the ten patients in group I developed recurrent disease and four of them eventually died of disease. Only one of 11 patients in group II died of metastatic disease and the remaining patients are free of disease with 19+ to 46+ months of follow-up. Of the six patients from group II who underwent surgical resection of apparently residual disease after chemotherapy but prior to radiotherapy, five were found to have completely necrotic tumor and one had microscopic disease on histologic examination, proving the efficacy of chemotherapy. Combined modality therapy including initial chemotherapy containing high doses of cisplatin provided rapid reduction in tumor burden and the results appeared superior to treatment that did not include initial chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 原発性性腺外セミノーマ（EGS）は、若年成人にまれにみられる腫瘍で、しばしば巨大な原発巣と転移性疾患を伴って発症する。従来の治療法（放射線療法の単独または手術との併用）では、長期生存は不十分である。初回に高用量シスプラチンによる化学療法を含む多モダリティ治療を受けた21例（第II群：11例）と、従来療法を受けた患者（第I群：10例）のカルテを検討した。第I群の10例中5例が再発し、そのうち4例は最終的に疾患により死亡した。第II群の11例中、転移性疾患で死亡したのは1例のみで、残りの患者は19ヵ月以上～46ヵ月以上の追跡期間中、無病であった。化学療法後に残存病変に対して放射線療法の前に外科的切除を受けた第II群の6例のうち、5例で完全壊死性腫瘍が認められ、1例で組織学的に顕微鏡的病変が認められた。これは化学療法の有効性を裏付けるものである。高用量シスプラチンを含む初回化学療法を併用した治療は、腫瘍量の迅速な減少をもたらし、初回化学療法を含まない治療より優れていると思われた。
